title: Circle of the Tyrants
reference: Versão de estúdio, To Mega Therion (1985)

parts.name: Verse
lyrics: The battle is over — The sands drunk the blood
All what there remains — The bitterness delusion
Immortality of the gods — Sits at their side
As they leave the walls behind — To reach the jewel's gleam

parts.name: Chorus
lyrics: Circle of the ty-hugh!
Circle of the ty-hugh!

parts.name: Brues
lyrics: Days have come — When the steel will rule
And upon his head — A crown of gold
I sing the ballads — Victory and defeat
I hear the tales — Of frozen mystery

parts.name: Tremelick
lyrics: Your hand wields the might — Tyrant's precursor
You carry the will — As the morning is near
Your hand wields the might — Tyrant's precursor
You carry the will — As the morning is near

parts.name: Brues
lyrics: New kingdoms rise — By the circle of the tyrants
In the land of darkness — The warrior that was me
Where the winds cannot reach — The tyrant's might was born
Often I look back — With tears in my eyes

parts.name: Simpliverso
lyrics: Grotesque glory — None will ever see them fall
Hunts and wars — Everlasting shadows
Grotesque glory — None will ever see them fall
Hunts and wars — Everlasting shadows
